title: Introduction
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://developers.envoy.com/hub/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

The Envoy API is REST-based. It accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.

Getting started? Check out our [quickstart guide](https://developers.envoy.com/hub/docs/make-your-first-api-request) to learn how to use the Envoy API.
